concept: IAM: cross-account read-only role for an external auditor
tests: LEAST-overhead way to give an auditor read-only access to all accounts in an Organization.
expected: A standard cross-account role with the ReadOnlyAccess managed policy in each account, assumed by the auditor from a single identity. Triggers: "read-only visibility", "many accounts", "single point of management", "LEAST overhead".
why_not: IAM users in each account mean many credentials; root credentials are insecure; disabling accounts makes no sense.
